checks: The interior gradient convex hull gives a uniform linear drop of the old max-min value, and uniqueness plus compactness gives a gap away from its old maximizer. Uniform parameter Lipschitz continuity then places every new maximizer at distance O(t).

Testing old active indices gives the uniform upper expansion. Any limit of new minimizing indices is old-active, and the old inactive gap is nonnegative, giving the lower expansion with the same linear envelope.

Coercivity from the sharpness bound ensures an attained h maximizer. The supporting hyperplane of the epigraph of the compact hull has positive vertical coefficient since zero is interior in the q projection. The dual objective equals the lowest ordinate at q=0.

Carathéodory on the exposed graph face gives at most d+1 active points. Reducing to a support-minimal positive dependence within that graph preserves the balanced cost, including a singleton zero-gradient case.

At proper unit-normal cuts the mark gradient is −S_j u_j. Reweighting by reciprocal areas gives the stated L. Uniform old-gap control removes other bases from the finite maximum, and differentiation of the common quotient gives the factor 1/M.

The selection criterion has the stated quantifier: failure for any selection permits a direction strictly negative on every selected functional; conversely a negative derivative chooses one such minimizer at each old deepest base. The single-deepest conclusion follows using all signed directions.
Verified §§1–5 of the source, including the distinction between a cap menu that really represents local depth and one convenient cover.

overlap.comparison: The reciprocal-area mean for one fixed regular circuit is the same algebraic response, but it is a cover upper bound in a prescribed visible-facet variation. It gives no derivative of the true sharp max-min over all active circuits.
The actual critical circuit existence result gives one minimal dependence at a restricted maximum, not the sharpness condition or a derivative over every balanced active law.

readability: The compact representation and uniform control are explicit assumptions. The proof does not assert that arbitrary mixed-depth maximizers have them. For the actual application, one can use the ambient depth on the fixed compact domains; points outside the canonical compatible hull have depth zero by separation.
review_method: Independent cold proof read of the frozen input, followed by original-source, pinned dependency and overlap comparison.
summary: Uniform localization and the compact balanced-probability dual give the directional formula with the minimum over every active circuit, under the stated sharpness and smooth representation hypotheses.
